title: Businesses Still Don’t See AI Returns, Consulting Exec Says
summary: <p>Here’s something worth paying attention to. According to consulting firm EY, businesses are still not seeing substantial revenue gains or cost reductions from using AI.</p><p>“I haven‘t met any clients that say I wanna slow down my spend on AI.
